sections.content: Use desde and desde hace with familiar verbs and vocabulary about friendship and languages. Expressions such as conocer a alguien, estudiar un idioma, hablar español and practicar español can describe activities or relationships that continue to the present. With conocer, use the present tense for an ongoing relationship: Nos conocemos desde hace tres meses.

items.spanish: Nos conocemos desde hace tres meses.
items.english: We have known each other for three months.

items.spanish: Estudio español desde el año pasado.
items.english: I have studied Spanish since last year.

items.spanish: Practicamos el idioma desde hace dos semanas.
items.english: We have practised the language for two weeks.
We have spoken Spanish since January.

sections.content: For an ongoing relationship, Spanish normally says Nos conocemos desde... or desde hace..., not a literal English-style perfect form.
